block.title: In-game enemy sprite sheet: skeet, vane, tender
block.positive: Retro 16-bit pixel art sprite atlas for a horizontal arcade shoot-'em-up, all sprites drawn at the same chunky resolution with bold near-black navy outlines on a flat dark blue drafting sheet, color reference hex 05070f background, evenly spaced grid, no text and no annotations. Content: a family of mechanical sky-patrol drones — seed-pod fighters with single magenta visor slits and folding petal hatches in four open/close stages; crescent-bladed interceptor discs whose three mirrored scythe wings are caught at four rotation angles; and one bulky flat carrier drone with green port lights and a bellied hangar bay, drawn broadside and three-quarter. Each species gets a small color-swatch bullet orb beside it: a pink sphere and a red sphere, both with bright cores and darker rims, to fix the palette. Limited saturated palette of gunmetal greys, rust-violet seams, magenta, green and steel blue. Crisp pixel clusters, no anti-aliasing, no soft shading — dithered highlights only.

block.notes: Square atlas suits a texture-page mockup. sd3.5 at guidance 5.5 keeps grid regularity. The bullet swatches double as palette anchors so extractions stay consistent.
